lines: You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Lubna eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Courgette chickpea pot
dishes.title: Chickpeas, courgettes, peppers and tomatoes
dishes.method: Take one lunch box of the chickpea pot, reheat it gently in a pan, then stir through the lemon juice and finish with the parsley.
dishes.why: This trades separate fresh plates for one warm pot that reheats well at work.

dishes.name: Herbed chickpea bowl
dishes.title: Chickpeas, courgettes, peppers, tomatoes, spinach and lemon
dishes.method: Reheat the named lunch box in a pan, fold in the spinach until just wilted, and finish with the lemon juice.
dishes.why: This gives the same warm, comforting pot a fresh green finish.

dishes.name: Smoky bean rice bowl
dishes.title: Black beans, brown rice, peppers, tomatoes and spinach
dishes.method: Take one dinner box, reheat it in a pan with the lime juice, and scatter over the coriander before serving.
dishes.why: This is a warm, filling dinner that keeps the cooking to one evening session.

dishes.name: Avocado bean supper
dishes.title: Black beans, brown rice, peppers, tomatoes, spinach and avocado
dishes.method: Reheat the named dinner box in a pan, then add the avocado and lime juice at the table.
dishes.why: This turns the reheatable chilli and rice into a cooler, fresh-tasting supper.

dishes.name: Smoky training bowl
dishes.title: Black beans, brown rice, peppers, tomatoes and spinach with coriander
dishes.method: Reheat the named dinner box in a pan, keeping the rice and beans together, then finish with lime juice and coriander.
dishes.why: The warm bean-and-rice bowl puts the starch directly into the evening meal after a long day.

preparations.title: Chickpea courgette pot
preparations.method: Dice the onion, courgettes and peppers. Warm the oil in a large pot, soften the onion for 3 minutes, add the peppers and courgettes, then stir in the tomatoes, chickpeas, water and cumin. Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes until thick and tender, then weigh the ready pot into the three named lunch boxes.

preparations.title: Black bean chilli with brown rice
preparations.method: Start the rice in a covered saucepan with 400 ml water. While it cooks, dice the onions and peppers, soften them in the oil in a second pot, then add the tomatoes, beans, paprika and remaining water. Simmer for 20 minutes, fold in the spinach to wilt, fluff the rice, combine the ready food and weigh it into four named dinner boxes.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Put the rice on first, then chop both sets of onions and peppers. Start the dinner chilli in the second pot, soften the lunch-pot vegetables in the first, and add their tomatoes and chickpeas. Let both pots simmer while the rice finishes, wilt the dinner spinach, combine the rice with the chilli, then weigh the lunch and dinner boxes straight away.
